notes.title: Gameplay fixes and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:

 Handpose changing while holding an item makes player not able to grab things again
 Player can't interact with anything after becoming a fist
 Can't move after changing pose and picking up extendable arm
 A player attached to the turning key is forced to "die", and therefore respawn in a location other than the turning key.
 Plateau of extendable arm rotates to the other player when extending, makes it difficult and sometimes impossible to grab handles and other items in puzzles
 multiple gameplay fixes and bugs
